Stone Energy successfully completed zone change operations on ST 164, OCS-G-01250, Well C-15ST2.  Operations began on August 2, 2009, and ended on August 5, 2009.  The previous producing interval, the "Tex-X-1" Sand, perfs 14425' - 14470' MD, was isolated by setting a MRBP @ 14345' MD and setting ~52' of cmt on top of the plug, ETOC @ 14293' MD. Zone change operations were successfully completed on EW 306, Well A-3ST3.  Operations began on May 9, 2010 and were completed on May 25, 2010.  The previous producing interval, the "LH" Sand, perfs 16310' - 16328' MD, was isolated by setting a MRBP @ 16295' MD and dumping 50' of cmt on top of the plug; ETOC @ 16245' MD. Leed has successfully completed perforation modification operations on the SS 201 A06 well, "KH" Sand completion to reduce water production.  

A MRBP was set at 12901' MD.   Resin and cement was dumped on top of the plug with the ETOC cement @ 12853' MD.  The operation successfully isolated the bottom portion of the "KH" Sand completion, perforation interval 12853' - 12896' MD.

Operations began on 01-31-11 and were completed on 02-04-11.

Stone has completed zone change operations on the VR 51 A-4 well to produce the "CC-1" sand. The previous completion, the "C01" sand, was isolated by pulling the 3-1/2" tubing string at 12,080' MD, setting a CIBP in the casing at 12,075' MD, and dumping 50' of cement on top of the plug, w/ ETOC at 12,025' MD. The "CC-1" sand was perforated at intervals 10,382'-10,392' MD. A CIBP was set at 10,399' MD and GP assy was set on top of CIBP. The "CC-1" sand was then gravel packed. Coil tubing was then utilized to perform an acid job on the well and jet the well with nitrogen to lift the well allowing for production to be established from the "CC-1" Sand. Operations began 03/25/2011 and ended 05/04/2011.

Stone has successfully completed operations on the EW 306 A-16 well to install a subsurface safety PB insert valve in the X-nipple at 471' MD to convert the operation of the downhole safety valve to subsea control. This has allowed for production to be restored from the well. Operations began and ended on 04/27/2011.

Anadarko received approval for a 14 day temporary zone change/test for EB 646 SS007 ST01. The DS-1 FB A sand was temporarily isolated and only the DS-1 FB A sand was produced temporarily.

Completed as a single stacked gravel packed completion in the Lower KJ/KK Sand with an unperforated selective in the LP Sand.  The Lower KJ/KK Sand will only be produced at this time.  A zone change could be submitted at a later date to commingle the sands.

Also please note:  The KJ/KK Sand is hooked up and ready to flow.  Due to Hurricane Ike, the well is temporarily shut-in.

Stone performed zone change operations on the PL 23, OCS-G-01238, Well C4ST1BP1 to produce the "CP 28" Sand.  Operations began on August 18, 2008, and were completed on September 30, 2008. The previous producing interval, the "CP 29" Sand was isolated by setting a posi-set plug @ 15310' MD and dumping 25' cmt on top of the plug, ETOC @ 15285'.  

The "CP 28" Sand was exposed to production by perforating from 15180' - 15192' MD.  The well was turned over to production on October 1, 2008; however, the "CP 28" watered out and did not produce at economic levels.  Test results for October 2, 2008:  38 MCFPD, 0 BCPD, 1600 BWPD.  A Notice of 1st Production is not being filed for the "CP 28" Sand completion interval.  The well is shut-in while waiting for zone change operations to be completed to produce the "CP24" Sand.
